description: UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology publishes MaRIUS-G2G-WAH2-monthly for assessing spatial drought and water scarcity in Great Britain. A 100-member weather@home2-driven Grid-to-Grid ensemble supplies monthly river flow and unsaturated-zone soil moisture on a 1 km grid. The archive covers 1900–2006, a 1975–2004 comparison baseline, 2020–2049 and 2070–2099. Flow is expressed in cubic metres per second and soil moisture in millimetres of water per metre of soil. NetCDF outputs include supporting catchment-area grids and gauge locations. EIDC applies the UKCEH Click-Through Licence: permitted personal or internal business use is royalty free, with redistribution and commercial derivative restrictions. File access and software execution were not tested. Limitations include monthly aggregation and dependence on the high-emission future scenario limit use for acute flood peaks or probabilistic claims across all emission pathways. These fields could drive water-allocation or irrigation stress simulations. They complement the daily MaRIUS ensemble with spatial soil-moisture information and gridded outputs.
